items.text: Flamethrower fuel gauge needle now correctly tracks fuel.
Mid‑reload magazine bug fixed, allowing smoother reloading.
Turn loop issue resolved when holding the Uzi, preventing stuck turning.
Front turret damage/accuracy rebalanced on PT boats.
Computer station dismount bug fixed, preventing players from getting stuck.
Various procedural generation fixes applied (river handling, water pipe placement, inland spawn locations, missing train entrance, underwater grass/rocks, river terrain behavior, river source gaps).
Fixed turn-in-place looping issue on the Uzi and other items.
Added TerrainHeightRaise objects to underground train tunnel junctions to prevent rare player and item deaths caused by terrain collision overlaps.
Fixed door placement and destruction refreshing only the modified door instead of all doors on the server.
Corrected deployable logic to check only the most recent building block changes rather than all nearby changes.
Fixed base occlusion not hiding contents under closed triangle ladder hatches.
Fixed base contents staying hidden behind armored doors when their hatch is open.
Fixed base occlusion not hiding contents behind closed industrial garage doors.
Restored sounds for entities that are room‑occluded so they can be heard properly.
Added all remaining guns to the game.
Increased the size of the large backpack and added burlap clothing for raids.
Adjusted the board missions tab to a fixed size and made it close with Escape or Tab keys.
Scouts now take longer to notice players, investigate glimpses, and appear more frequently around large monuments.
Reduced roadside junk piles on the raid map by half.
Enabled quick crafting of pies during raids.
Added quick craft queueing and canceling for pies, plus smoother movement while crafting.
Updated deployment area visuals, added a static hatch and computer, and removed vending machines from the extraction outpost.
Melee swings now align with the crosshair and gathering hits no longer cause camera knockback.
Adjusted reticle stance, added a shoulder‑camera tuning panel, introduced a thirds‑overlay option, and refined default camera settings.
Fixed an issue where half‑walls could be placed with an incorrect underside, improving building stability.
Resolved a disconnect bug affecting CH‑47 helicopters, reducing unexpected drops from the sky.
Various snake AI fixes to prevent erratic behavior and improve encounter consistency.
Fixed loot containers that could spoil incorrectly and adjusted stash decay rates for more predictable resource loss.
Fixed a bug where player pings were not reliably sent in non‑reliable (NRE) mode.
Implemented several QoL improvements to the workshop UI and interaction flow.
Added the Seagull Trophy, a new achievement item for players.
Flamethrower now shows fuel correctly and reloads complete reliably, fixing the empty‑gauge and mid‑reload bugs.
Uzi turn‑loop issue resolved, eliminating the stuck‑turning behavior and improving handling.
PT boat front turret rebalanced for more appropriate damage and smoother handling.
Added extra TerrainHeightRaise objects in underground train tunnel junctions, preventing rare deaths from terrain collision overlap.
Door placement and destruction now affect only the targeted door, and deployables check only the most recent building changes, reducing unintended breakage.
Base occlusion visuals fixed: ladders, armored doors, and industrial garage doors now correctly hide interior contents when closed.
Sounds from room‑occluded entities are audible again, restoring expected audio cues.
Scouts take longer to notice and investigate brief sightings, especially near large monuments, making stealth approaches more viable.
Backpack size increased for raids and burlap clothing is now available, expanding inventory capacity and outfit options.
Roadside junk piles on the raid map have been halved, clearing pathways and reducing clutter.

Several quality‑of‑life upgrades: missions board tab now closes with Escape/Tab, shoulder camera aligns the barrel with the crosshair, quick‑craft pie added for fast food, quick‑craft queueing and cancellation with smoother movement, melee swings line up with the crosshair, and reticle/camera settings have been refined.
Fixed river source gaps, eliminating water holes that could trap players or disrupt base building.
Stopped terrain from being raised around rivers, providing smoother riverbanks for construction.
Restored missing train station entrances, re-enabling access to train travel.
Adjusted inland spawn placement to prevent spawns in undesirable interior locations.
Prevented water pipes from spawning on roads, removing obstruction to road networks.
Improved river avoidance logic in terrain generation, reducing structures intersecting rivers.
Added the remaining weapon types, expanding the arsenal available to players.
Re-enabled rockets on patrol helicopters, restoring their combat capability.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from properly dismounting from computer stations.
Corrected off‑center snapping, ensuring buildings align accurately to the grid.

Increase deploy and clear bounds for sleeping bags and towels to improve placement.

Various third‑person weapon attachment fixes.
Correct silencer muzzle offsets for all weapons.
Add dynamic monument map markers that can update label text and position at runtime.

Fixed lingering first‑person view elements in the shoulder camera during extraction, removing visual artifacts.
Adjusted tattoo stencil sizing to use screen space, aligning head and body tattoo sizes correctly.

items.text: Backpack items are now included in all inventory searches and item transfers, streamlining crafting and item management.
Supplier missions, in‑raid crafting lists, and shop listings have been fixed, ensuring reliable mission rewards and crafting options.
Contraband loot tier has been rebalanced for a more consistent reward curve.
2‑module car prefabs now have correct IDs, eliminating errors when deploying those vehicles.
A crash caused by loading a vine that had already finished swinging has been resolved, improving overall stability.
Cobalt tattoo stencil pack now unlocks its stencils directly via the Steam item, making the new designs immediately usable.
Watercatcher and chicken coop loot panels now automatically select the bucket when it’s in the belt, and disabled blueprints display a clear “cannot learn” tooltip.
Sleeping bag respawns no longer trap players in tight spaces, and respawning on a bag now requires clicking the bag, preventing accidental stuck situations.
Loot reveal order at extraction now shows forward items first and the best last, with adjusted reveal range for smoother looting.
Extraction balloons are now indestructible, ensuring they remain functional throughout the extraction phase.
New balloon doors, Burn & Extract mechanic, hub sounds, and balloon platforms with consoles and sirens have been added to the extraction hub, expanding interactive elements.
Bandit patrols cover a wider area, guards will search for lost players, and a door‑unlock cue has been added for clearer navigation.
Hidden shop unlocks, a hub radio, and a fixed shop scroll UI enhance the outpost’s commerce experience.
Turn‑in‑place animation no longer restarts when equipping items mid‑turn.
Sleeping bags no longer get stuck on respawn, ensuring proper placement.
